This repo appears to be empty — there's no change-tracking tool or packet folder present here, so I can't inspect the actual health-check logic or file layout.

That said, based on what you've described, here's my recommendation: **delete the `add-dark-mode-toggle` packet folder entirely.** It's not a case of "needs more work" (that's what `scaffold` usually flags) — it's a decision that was already made in the team meeting to not pursue the feature this quarter, and nothing from it merged. Keeping it around as a stale scaffold just adds noise to the status report for something that isn't actually planned work anymore. If you want a record of the idea for later (e.g., once the color palette is finalized), jot a note in an issue tracker or wiki instead of leaving a dead packet in the active folder — that keeps the health check clean without losing the context.

For `refactor-auth-flow`, since it's actively being worked on, that's a separate fix: the right move there is for your teammate to add the missing required file (or you coordinate with them), not to remove the packet.

Want me to look at the actual tool/packet structure if you point me to the right path, so I can give you the exact command or file to remove?
